faqs.intro: Get direct answers to common questions regarding custom web application development timelines, architecture, source code ownership, and pricing.

items.q: What is the difference between a website and a web application?
items.a: A website primarily presents information for visitors to read. A web application allows authenticated users to complete tasks, process transactions, manipulate data, and generate reports. Common examples include customer portals, internal CRMs, analytics dashboards, and SaaS platforms.

items.q: What does web application development cost in Kochi?
items.a: Custom web application development in Kochi typically ranges from ₹3,00,000 for a focused MVP to ₹15,00,000 for standard business software, and ₹15,00,000 to ₹40,00,000+ for large enterprise multi-tenant systems. Cost depends on user roles, workflow complexity, and integration requirements.

items.q: How long does custom web application development take?
items.a: A focused MVP takes 2 to 3 months. Standard multi-department applications require 3 to 4 months, and complex enterprise platforms take 4 to 6 months. We provide a milestone-based timeline with weekly sprint reviews before starting.

items.q: Will I own the source code and database?
items.a: Yes. Upon project completion and final milestone clearance, 100% of the intellectual property, full source code repositories, database schemas, and cloud deployment credentials belong entirely to your company.

items.q: Can you build an MVP first and add features later?
items.a: Yes. We actively recommend this approach. Building a lean MVP with core functionality in 2 to 3 months allows you to validate real market demand and onboard initial users before investing in secondary features.

items.q: What technologies and frameworks do you use?
items.a: We build modern frontend interfaces using React, Next.js, and Vue.js. For backend services and APIs, we utilize Node.js (NestJS/Express) and Python (FastAPI/Django). Databases include PostgreSQL, Redis, and MongoDB, hosted on AWS or Azure.

items.q: Can you connect the web app to our existing software?
items.a: Yes. We build custom API connectors to sync your web app with existing ERPs (SAP, Tally), accounting software, payment gateways (Razorpay, Stripe), and legacy databases without manual double data entry.

items.q: Who hosts and maintains the application after launch?
items.a: We deploy applications to your company's own AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure account so you maintain complete control. We offer monthly SLA maintenance packages starting from ₹20,000/month covering server monitoring, security updates, and performance optimization.

items.q: How secure is your web application development?
items.a: We implement industry-standard OWASP security guidelines, mandatory HTTPS/TLS 1.3 encryption, salted password hashing, role-based access control (RBAC), SQL injection safeguards, and automated vulnerability scanning before deployment.
